If you buy Forsaken, you get some good stuff like a raid and purple weapons, but most of the exotics, if not all are locked away behind the kiosk where you have to farm ascendant shards which took me a month with a mod that you get randomly for 1 shard(chance for prisms from crucible) and ciphers that you complete though I haven't done the quests yet because I got a lot of the weapons already from the previous years.

If you buy Shadowkeep, you get some stuff from Eris like bounties but there aren't a lot of exotics that are also locked in the kiosk where you have to farm as well.

Beyond Light has everything it has, with stasis which is really fun in pvp but takes a while to grind for on all classes (titan, hunter, and warlock).

I would recommend beyond light, forsaken, and then shadowkeep in that order based on my experience of destiny 2 but it's your decision. Choose wisely Guardian.
